QUESTION: What is the maximum duration of paid sick leave per calendar year?

EXCERPTS (may already contain the answer):
[leave_policy.pdf#3]
[leave_policy.pdf > 2. Sick leave] 2. Sick leave

2.1 Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per calendar year. Sick leave does not carry forward.

2.2 A medical certificate from a registered medical practitioner is required for sick leave longer than 2 consecutive days.

2.3 Sick leave cannot be combined with annual leave to extend a holiday without HR approval.

[leave_policy.pdf#2]
[leave_policy.pdf > 1. Annual leave] 1. Annual leave

1.1 Permanent employees earn 24 working days of annual leave per calendar year, accrued at 2 days per completed month of service.

1.2 Employees in their first year may take annual leave only after completing 3 months of service.

1.3 Up to 10 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the next year. Carried-forward days must be used by 30 June of that year or they lapse.

1.4 Leave of more than 5 consecutive working days must be applied for at least 15 calendar days in advance through the HR portal and approved by the line manager.

1.5 Leave encashment: on resignation, unused annual leave up to a maximum of 30 days is paid out at basic salary.

[leave_policy.pdf#4]
[leave_policy.pdf > 3. Parental leave] 3. Parental leave

3.1 Maternity leave: 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the first two children, and 12 weeks for the third child onwards. Up to 8 weeks may be taken before the expected delivery date.

3.2 Paternity leave: 10 working days of paid leave, to be taken within 3 months of the birth or adoption.

3.3 Adoption leave: 12 weeks for an adoptive mother of a child under 3 months old.

3.4 Employees must notify HR in writing at least 8 weeks before planned parental leave begins, except in medical emergencies.

[leave_policy.pdf#5]
[leave_policy.pdf > 4. Public holidays] 4. Public holidays

4.1 The company observes 10 public holidays per year. The list is published by HR every December.

4.2 Staff required to work on a public holiday receive a compensatory day off, to be taken within 60 days.

5. Contact Questions not covered by this policy should be sent to the HR Business Partner at hr.helpdesk@meridian-marine.example or raised as a ticket on the HR portal. Note: the older 2022 policy allowing 15 carry-forward days no longer applies.

Document HR-RW-02, effective 1 January 2025.

## A. Work from home (WFH)

A1. Shore staff may work from home up to 2 days per week after completing probation, with line-manager approval.

A2. WFH is not available to Technical Superintendents during a vessel's dry-docking period or to Marine
Operations staff on the 24x7 duty roster.

to 20 working days per calendar year.
